setup: q in Q, q!=0,+/-1; A=x^2+q^2, B=(1+q^2)x^2+4q^2x+q^2(1+q^2). The only locally viable squareclasses are d=1,2.

d1.rational_base_point: t=1, W=2*sqrt(1+q^2); every locked q=a/b has a^2+b^2=c^2, so sqrt(1+q^2)=c/b is rational

d2.receiver_note: These base points are the already-locked order-4 Face-3 poles and give genus-one solubility only.

binary_quartic_invariants.convention: For f=a t^4+b t^3+c t^2+d t+e: I=12ae-3bd+c^2; J=72ace+9bcd-27ad^2-27b^2e-2c^3.
binary_quartic_invariants.convention_crosscheck: The same I,J convention applied to the audited Stage31 quartic 5Y^4+40Y^3+90Y^2-40Y+5 gives I=13200,J=-3024000 and hence y^2=x^3-275x+1750, exactly the Stage31 source-locked elliptic model.
